final: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_duration) as avg_rental_duration, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) as avg_ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_rental_duration, avg_ratio FROM per_rating UNION ALL SELECT 'OVERALL', AVG(avg_rental_duration), AVG(avg_ratio) FROM per_rating
